issues.description: The problem statement gives conflicting guidance about the calculateTotalPrice method: the UML lists +calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (an instance method) while a later textual note explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static. The provided Main.java (template) calls calculateTotalPrice via an instance (shop.calculateTotalPrice(...)), which suggests instance usage, but the reference solution implements calculateTotalPrice as static. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether to declare the method static and how to call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the intended visibility in the problem statement and UML: either (A) require calculateTotalPrice to be static (update the UML to indicate a static method and adjust the example Main to call SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...)), or (B) require it to be an instance method (remove the note requiring it to be static). Ensure the Main example and the UML match the chosen design.
